name: SOC Triage – Wazuh Alert Response
description: Receives Wazuh alerts (level ≥ 7) via webhook, enriches them with threat-intel context, routes by severity, and automatically isolates hosts or disables accounts for critical alerts.

parameters.code:
import json
alert = json.loads(exec_input)
rule_level = int(alert.get('rule', {}).get('level', 0))
rule_id    = str(alert.get('rule', {}).get('id', ''))
rule_desc  = alert.get('rule', {}).get('description', '')
agent_name = alert.get('agent', {}).get('name', 'unknown')
agent_ip   = alert.get('agent', {}).get('ip', 'unknown')
win_data   = alert.get('data', {}).get('win', {}).get('eventdata', {})
username   = win_data.get('targetUserName') or win_data.get('subjectUserName') or 'unknown'
logon_type = win_data.get('logonType', '')
return json.dumps({'rule_level': rule_level, 'rule_id': rule_id, 'rule_desc': rule_desc, 'agent_name': agent_name, 'agent_ip': agent_ip, 'username': username, 'logon_type': logon_type})

parameters.subject: [HIGH] Wazuh Alert Level $parse_alert.rule_level on $parse_alert.agent_name
parameters.body:
Alert Details:

User     : $parse_alert.username
Agent    : $parse_alert.agent_name  ($parse_alert.agent_ip)
Rule     : $parse_alert.rule_id
Desc     : $parse_alert.rule_desc
Logon    : $parse_alert.logon_type

Please investigate immediately.
